  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Abedi < Arabic ʿabid (عابد) = worshipper, devotee; suffix -i = relational/adjectival; from ʿabada = to serve, worship",
    "reading": "One who serves or worships; a devotee, servant of the divine.",
    "languages": ["ar"],
    "source": "Wehr, A Dictionary of Modern Written Arabic",
    "confidence": 0.9
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "A + bed + i; bed (Old English bedd) = resting place; i = first-person pronoun in Latin/French",
    "reading": "I am the bed, the resting ground of the word; a place where sound lies down.",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Abedi ~ French 'à bédi' (à + bédi, archaic for 'béni' = blessed); also ~ Hebrew 'avadi' (עֲבָדִי) = my servant",
    "reading": "To the blessed one; my servant — a doubled servitude and benediction.",
    "languages": ["fr", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Abedi -> A + B + E + D + I; reorder to 'Idea B' or 'Bide A'; bide (Old English bīdan) = to wait, remain",
    "reading": "A second idea, or an imperative to wait: the word holds a pause within itself.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "A-B-E-D-I as initials: A (alpha) + B (beta) + E (epsilon) + D (delta) + I (iota) — Greek letters in sequence but with E and D swapped",
    "reading": "A disordered alphabet — the first five letters rearranged, suggesting a hidden order or a broken beginning.",
    "languages": ["grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "A = beginning; B = house (beth, Hebrew); E = breath/heh; D = door (daleth); I = self/eye (iod)",
    "reading": "From the house of breath, through the door, the self emerges — a path of initiation.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Abedi: A=1, B=2, E=5, D=4, I=9 (Hebrew gematria values); sum = 21; 21 = 3×7, or 2+1=3",
    "reading": "Sum 21 — the number of completion and divine order; reduces to 3, the triad of creation.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Abedi < Latin 'ab' (from) + 'edi' (from edere = to eat) — but 'abedi' as ablative of 'abedus'? Not attested; speculative",
    "reading": "From the eating — a consuming origin, but this is a false trail, a phonetic mirage.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "Lewis & Short, A Latin Dictionary (no entry; generative)",
    "confidence": 0.2
  }
]
